notes.title: Version 1.13
notes.notes:
Recently we received several feedbacks, suggest the log system may run out of order due to some unknown reasons. After a detailed investigation, we find the problem is caused by one error command during data saving process. We have already report this bug to Ren'Py Engine, but until now we haven't got an answer yet.

　　Before Ren'Py Engine officially fix this bug, in order to avoid anything trouble for you, we temporarily shut down part of the game’s saving system, including:
　　● Interface of weekend's dormitory
　　● Interface of item purchasing
　　● Interface of magic house
　　In addition to these, menu function shall be closed during dormitory's scenario. You can reopen in other scenario.

　　If you already suffered relevant problems, we are really sorry about that. But we got no idea to recover your save data before Ren'Py Engine officially provide any solution. Now we are doing our best to cooperate with Ren'Py Engine, wish to settle this problem as early as we can. Please keep patient, thanks.

notes.title: Version 1.09
notes.notes:
● Updated some English translation.
● Updated Ren'Py engine to 6.99.12.

* To all 64-bit Ubuntu users:
If you cannot start your game after updating Steam client recently, please make sure you update Steam client and game client to the latest version, in most cases the issue won’t occur again.
If the issue remains, it is still caused by Steam Runtime. It is most likely that your Steam client have crashed during its installation, due to the issue of Steam Runtime.
Currently there is no official solution to it, to run the game, you can:
1. Run ‘BloodCode.sh’ from game root folder, OR
2. Enter the following command in Ubuntu terminal (you’ll have to do it every time you start Steam)
LD_PRELOAD='/usr/$LIB/libstdc++.so.6 /usr/$LIB/libgcc_s.so.1 /usr/$LIB/libxcb.so.1 /usr/$LIB/libgpg-error.so' /usr/bin/steam

For other solutions, such as saving the command as a desktop shortcut, or using Steam Native Runtime, please refer to
https://wiki.archlinux.org/index.php/Steam/Troubleshooting#Steam_runtime_issues

notes.title: Version 1.08
notes.notes:
We appreciate the assistance of Bo Feng Ling for the balance adjustments made in this version.
● Balance adjustments:
■ In order to coordinate with the adjustment made to Locke’s route in last version, requirements of entering Locke’s route are all lowered.
■ All attribute requirements of entering a character’s route are lowered.
■ Made adjustment to the divide of attribute levels.
■ Slightly lowered the gain of optional courses.
■ Made adjustments to the gain and loss of free activities, made it possible to relieve fatigue via free activities.
■ Raised the income of normal works, slightly lowered gained attribute from normal works.
■ Raised the gold income of special works, besides, if you fail in a special work now, gold will no longer be reduced to negative.
■ Made adjustments to the prices and functions of cakes.
■ Made adjustments to the prices and functions of presents, besides, if you give an inappropriate present, you will get a reduced amount of favor instead of no favor.
■ Made adjustments to the price of cushions.
■ Adjusted date success conditions: Dates will always be successful at early stage of the game; at middle and late stage, favor is required for a successful date, required favor is proportional to the number of days passed in game.
■ Added a DLC that contains 4 costumes, which provide bonus to all your attributes and grant you special bonus effects. Can be used in saved games from earlier versions of the game once purchased.

● Added Russian translation.
● Added a "Help" button to the operating menu. Players who have skipped the tutorial or have questions about the arrangement screen can review help content via this button.
● Fixed other bugs.
